enable_clap_index.label: Enable Character index
enable_clap_index.description: Also build a second usearch index over the 1024-dim CLAP audio embeddings already stored by sonic_analysis. Enables track-to-track semantic similarity via the sonic_similarity/similar_clap API. Requires no extra downloads — uses embeddings already on disk.

enable_text_search.label: Enable free-text search
enable_text_search.description: Enable natural-language track search (e.g. 'super dancy disco') via the CLAP GPT2 text encoder, exposed as sonic_similarity/text_search. First-time use lazily downloads ~500MB of GPT2 weights to the local HuggingFace cache — the model is loaded on the first query, not at plugin start. Implicitly enables the Character index above (text and audio share the same 1024-dim joint embedding space).

similar_tracks_engine.label: Similar Tracks engine
similar_tracks_engine.description: Which index powers library-wide Similar Tracks. Traits matches on measured sound traits (tempo, energy, loudness, key); Character matches on overall feel — how a listener would describe the sound.

similar_tracks_preset.label: Similar Tracks preset
similar_tracks_preset.description: Similarity weight preset applied to the Similar Tracks action (Traits engine only). 'balanced' weights each trait by how much it drives sonic similarity; 'vibe' weights mood + timbre; 'party' weights rhythm + regularity; 'genre_era' stays close to the seed's genre and decade; 'discover' favours novelty (low genre/era weighting).

similar_tracks_diversity.label: Similar Tracks diversity
similar_tracks_diversity.description: 0 keeps results closest to the seed; 10 maximises variety via MMR (some results may be less similar but more distinct from each other). Traits engine only.

enable_discover_row.label: Show 'Inspired by recently played' on the discover page
enable_discover_row.description: Yield a discover-page row seeded by your recently-played tracks. Disable to suppress the row without uninstalling the plugin.

discover_engine.label: Discover row engine
discover_engine.description: Which index seeds the discover row. Traits matches on measured sound traits; Character matches on overall feel. Character requires the Character index (Generic section) to be enabled — the row falls back to Traits otherwise.

discover_preset.label: Discover row preset
discover_preset.description: Similarity weight preset used to rank candidates for the row (Traits engine only). 'discover' favours novelty (low genre/era weighting); 'balanced' weights each trait by how much it drives sonic similarity; 'vibe' weights mood + timbre; 'party' weights rhythm + regularity; 'genre_era' stays close to the seed's genre and decade.

discover_diversity.label: Discover row diversity
discover_diversity.description: 0 keeps results closest to the seeds; 10 maximises variety via MMR (some results may be less similar but more distinct from each other). Traits engine only.

rebuild_18dim_index.label: Rebuild Traits index
rebuild_18dim_index.description: Re-scan all stored signatures and rebuild the weighted-Euclidean search index. Runs in the background; refresh the page to see updated counts.

rebuild_clap_index.label: Rebuild Character index
rebuild_clap_index.description: Incrementally re-scan audio_analysis rows and add any missing CLAP embeddings to the 1024-dim index. Runs in the background; refresh the page to see updated counts.

manifest.description: Powers library-wide Similar Tracks, radio mode, and a discover-page row using local audio signatures. Requires both sonic_analysis (perceptual scalars + CLAP embedding) and smart_fades (BPM + musical key) — vector assembly skips tracks missing either signal.

errors.clap_index_unavailable: The Character index is not available; check the provider logs and reload the provider before rebuilding.
